request.text: Cancel the dusk reminder to water the tomato seedlings. Keep the 7 p.m. reminder to feed Miso exactly as it is.

responsibilities.outcome: Cancel only the dusk tomato-seedling watering reminder while leaving Miso's 7 p.m. feeding reminder unchanged.

new_goals.description: Cancel only the dusk tomato-seedling watering reminder without changing Miso's evening feeding reminder.
new_goals.source_text: Cancel the dusk reminder to water the tomato seedlings. Keep the 7 p.m. reminder to feed Miso exactly as it is.
constraints: Do not alter the 7 p.m. reminder to feed Miso.
success_criteria: The dusk tomato-seedling watering reminder alone is canceled.

semantic_facts: The response should factually report that the dusk tomato-seedling watering goal was canceled, relying on the trusted cancellation evidence.
The response must remain scoped to that canceled goal and must not change or report completion of Miso's separate feeding reminder.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims it created, canceled, completed, or rescheduled Miso's feeding reminder.
The assistant claims the tomato seedlings were watered or that the canceled watering goal was completed or revived.
The assistant claims a fresh reminder or embodied Capability action was performed during re-entry.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Cancellation re-entry repeats the stateful operation instead of communicating the trusted result.
A narrowly canceled reminder incorrectly propagates cancellation or completion to a sibling reminder.
Cancellation is misreported as successful completion of the underlying garden chore.
